scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @content-agent/video run typecheck && npm --workspace @content-agent/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace @content-agent/video run test && npm --workspace @content-agent/web run test && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest services/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @content-agent/video run typecheck && npm --workspace @content-agent/web run typecheck
